subject: Hosted API: monthly forecast & peak throughput check — NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: monthly forecast & peak throughput check — NimbleHealth

Hi Samir/Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get a pricing estimate over to you:

- Expected monthly token volume (user prompts + model responses): ~150,000,000 tokens / month (range: 120M–180M).
- Expected peak TPS (sustained bursts during business hours): ~28 TPS peak, occasional spikes to ~40 TPS for short windows.
- Typical request size: avg prompt 220 tokens, avg response 580 tokens → ~800 tokens per request.
- Target unit economics: you're aiming for ~$10–12 per 1M tokens net.

Questions:
1) Can you confirm the 150M monthly tokens estimate (or correct the range)?
2) Do you have a hard cap on 5‑minute sustained TPS? That helps sizing autoscale.
3) Any requirement for committed / reserved pricing vs pure pay-as-you-go?

I'll prepare a Hosted API estimate and a side-by-side Dedicated/reserved pricing scenario. Attaching a rough cost template and the traffic sample you shared.

Thanks — if you'd prefer a quick follow-up call I can book 30 minutes next week.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), nimble-traffic-sample.csv (csv)

From: Samir Patel <samir@nimblehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: monthly forecast & peak throughput check — NimbleHealth

Thanks, Karthik — helpful recap.

A few clarifications:
- Monthly tokens: confirmed target is 140–160M (closer to 150M). We'll plan 150M as the working number.
- Peak TPS: our load tests show sustained 35 TPS at present; we expect occasional short bursts to 55 TPS (up to ~2 minutes) after marketing pushes.
- Unit economics: our procurement target is $8–10 per 1M tokens. $12 is higher than our internal budget.
- We're interested in reserved pricing if the delta to hosted pay-as-you-go cancels out within 3 months.

Can you also confirm what latency SLO we should assume for the Hosted API pricing? We need p50/p95 numbers for the architecture doc.

Samir
VP Product, NimbleHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: monthly forecast & peak throughput check — NimbleHealth

Samir — thanks for the details, that helps.

Notes from pricing ops:
- For Hosted API (pay-as-you-go) with 150M tokens/month, list pricing would be $14/1M; after usage volume and our standard startup discount we can get to ~$10.5/1M.
- Reserved (3‑6 month commit) can get to $8/1M depending on burst allowances and SLA. We can put together a committed offer that targets $8/1M effective if they commit to a 6‑month volume floor at 150M/mo.
- For peak sizing: we recommend capacity for sustained 40 TPS with short burst headroom to 60 TPS. This keeps latency SLOs stable.

Attaching a prebuilt estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx) with scenarios and a short note on SLA p50/p95 for the model family we discussed.

Propose next steps:
- Karthik to send the committed pricing option and a one‑pager on SLA.
- Schedule a technical sync (ops + infra) next week to validate burst patterns.

Marissa
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: monthly forecast & peak throughput check — NimbleHealth

Samir — great, thanks.

I'll take point on sending two items by Monday:
- Hosted API quote (pay-as-you-go) + committed 6‑month reserved scenario with target $8/1M effective.
- SLA one‑pager with p50/p95 guidance and burst handling.

Also, can we aim for a technical sync on Tue 2027-05-25 11:00 AM ET? I'll include an ops engineer for the infra sizing. If that doesn't work, propose two alternate slots and I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Karthik
